newsitem.title: CHINA: China's stocks next-day settlement not to change.
newsitem.headline: China's stocks next-day settlement not to change.

text.p: China's two stock markets have no plans to change the current system of next-day settlement, or T-plus-one, the China Securities said on Wednesday.
"The two stock exchanges have no plans to change the T-plus-one settlement system," the newspaper said in a large front-page box.
"Rumours to that effect in the markets are completely baseless," the notice said.

The markets in Shanghai and in southern Shenzhen have been rife with rumours this week that authorities planned to change the system to three-day settlement in a further measure to dampen speculation on China's volatile markets.
